raw:
During your mid-morning break, you find Owen at one of the foyer tables with a mug of tea and a tape measure beside him. A stack of folded café tables waits near the wall.

You ask how his week is going.

He looks toward the stack. “Busy enough. I’m helping Nell get the foyer into something people can actually use without walking into a carton.”

He takes a sip of tea. “Not bad, though. Better than some of the jobs I’ve had.”

His eyes flick briefly toward the staircase. “How’s the archive treating you?”
